page.layout: One column of running text, set left of centre. In the right margin, beside the lines "Atque" to "ganos", one marginal note of three lines. Below the text: the signature "E 4" at left and the catchword "mag-" at right. Running head at top centre, page number at top right.

main_text.l: modum afflicta, & cum civitate tota re-
gio vicina in partes distracta, sese attri-
verant, velut calamitate cautiores factae
ab anno M. CC. LII diu deinceps quietae
fuere. Post cum minuti tumultus in Agro
inter ipsos agrarios ex ambitione hic illic
rursus exisserent, deinde majores quoque,
imprimis vero in Fivelingiis renasceren-
tur, civitas tamen in quiete perstitit, &
quasi spectatrix fabulae fuit. Et quoniam
vacillabat saepè jurisdictio in Agro ob par-
tium studia, contumaciamque poten-
tium, quibus pro jure vis ac libido erant,
simul etiam commercia actionibus vio-
lentis turbabantur, tum firmandorum
judiciorum, tum commerciorum tuen-
dorum causa cum his aut illis agri parti-
bus, ut occasio ferebat, pactis fœderi-
busque eadem se civitas junxit, eoque
modo publicae pacis anchora fuit. Atque
haec pax cum ad annum usque M. CCC.
XXXII stetisset, intereaque opibus &
negotiationum multitudine oppidani
crevissent, eo, quem dixi, anno in dis-
sensionem cum sociis suis, ex dissensione
in tumultus, ex tumultibus in apertum &

page.notes: The marginal note's last word "ganos." runs across a line break ("Gronin" / "ganos."); the join is read as "Groninganos" without a printed hyphen, so check it. The numerals are printed in small capitals and are given here as capitals. The scattered marks at the far right edge are not text and are left out. The text "saepè" and "fœderibusque" are read as printed, with the hyphen at the line end kept after "fœderi-".
